title: Juya ƙwarewar dashboard ɗin ku zuwa sabis ɗin da aka biya

say: Juya ƙwarewar dashboard ɗin ku zuwa sabis ɗin da aka biya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module uku na Advanced Excel da Dashboards.
Yawancin ayyukan Excel waɗanda ba daidai ba suna yin haka kafin a rubuta dabara ɗaya. Maginin ya yi ginshiƙi lokacin da mai shi ke son sanin wanda ke bi bashin kuɗi.

say: Na farko, ƙimar ta. Aƙalla Naira 400,000 a kowane wata sama da sa’o’i 50 da ake iya biya na nufin akalla Naira 8,000 a kowace awa.
Ta ƙididdige kowane lokaci: ganowa, bayanan tsaftacewa, dabaru, shimfidawa, gwaji, da umarni tare da horo. Wato awa 31 kenan. Matsakaicin kashi 20 cikin ɗari yana kawo shi zuwa 37.
Awanni 37 a 8,000 Naira 296,000 ne, don haka ta ba da 300,000 don gyara aikin.

say: Rabi a sanya hannu, rabi a kan mika mulki.

card.title: Farashi dashboard ɗin kuɗin makaranta

say: Rubuta wannan rarrabuwa a cikin shawarar ku. Gyara kurakurai, ƙananan gyare-gyare da zagaye biyu na bita sun haɗa.

panel.heading: Hade, ko neman canji?
left: Gyara kurakurai a cikin abubuwan da aka amince
right: Ƙara lissafin albashi ko hannun jari

say: Wani sabon rahoto, sabon tushen bayanai ko sake fasalin buƙatun canji ne. Kar a ce e ko a'a kai tsaye. Aika gajeriyar bayanin kula tare da ƙarin sa'o'i, farashi da sabon kwanan wata, kuma bari abokin ciniki ya yanke shawara.

say: Daftari daga asusun kasuwanci ko sanannen dandamalin biyan kuɗi, kuma tabbatar da kowane canja wuri a cikin app ɗin ku na banki.

Raba hotunan kariyar kwamfuta ko PDF don amincewa. Aika fayil ɗin aiki da zarar an biya.
